# Independent semantic audit A

Compared actual source HEAD ab266415be98badcee06d06253c43921e1449614 with target HEAD e1b49a272dd1a39b8e0e0d59981d72ec25e85005. No parity report or other review results used; no edits except this report. Static instruction/runtime tracing, not a claim that roles were executed.

## Reachable portable behavior traced

AGENTS.block → kty-harness Skill → workflow routes clarifier, research decision, collector/evaluator, architect + separate design A/B, planner + separate plan A/B, developer, code A/B, conditional security/test, explanation delivery, independent completion audit. The CLI readonly_role reads the role TOML/profile/principles in a separate ephemeral read-only process; role TOMLs lead to the workflow/research/explanation contracts. Native/direct-instruction fallback and no-independent-call disclosure are explicit. Actual read-only routing avoids receipts and file writing.

Research retains metadata, RC IDs, original-source verification in a separate context, 30/30/20/20 score axes, conflicts/COI/currentness checks, rejection/hold distinction, evaluator no supplementation, adopted-only synthesis, bounded recollection. Decision routing retains task-local prior decisions, stage progress/archive, ADR triggers/alternatives/consequences/prior links, deduplicated specialist escalation. Google canon, bundled original guides, readable-writing, style-before-write/review, actual style check and explanations grounded in diff/code are reachable.

Allowed differences were not treated as findings: Sol+Sol/no effort pin; no PR/push/external AI/private vault/Claude plugin requirements; no repeated zero-finding quotas; actual readonly limits; explicitly limited native hook enforcement.

## Concrete portable gaps

1. HIGH — Singleton cross-verification lost dependency-scoped rejection validity. Source orchestrator singleton (8) requires all scenario-dependent files and working-tree hashes, invalidates rejection when any change/disappearance occurs, and forbids reuse with an empty dependency block. Target workflow 107–112 and roles Sol+Sol section require same A/B state and appropriate rerun after edits, but no dependency set or hash-backed rule for reusing a prior rejection on partial resume. decision-memory preserves old results and permits affected-stage-only resume. A change in a downstream file supporting a previously rejected scenario can therefore escape re-verification while a prior dismissal is retained. Preserve the semantic requirement with task-local or conversational dependency hashes; original filenames/PR machinery are unnecessary.

2. MEDIUM — Singleton verification is no longer a tightly bounded adversarial task. Source singleton (3)–(7) specifies one named finding, attempt to refute, no full review/new findings, file:line counterevidence, one decision; uncertainty escalates to the user and delegated uncertainty defaults conservatively. Target workflow says opposite-side new review, concrete counterexample/reproduction and leaves uncertainty unresolved, but omits single-finding scope, no-new-findings/nonrecursive boundary, explicit counterevidence requirements and uncertainty/delegation routing. A generic reviewer can reopen the whole review or leave a high-risk uncertainty without an actionable exit. Add a reduced cross-check contract reachable from workflow/roles; no new agent file is needed.

3. MEDIUM — Class-level closure after a review fix is absent. Source orchestrator common operating rules explicitly require closing the defect class rather than a single reported instance, checking equivalent statements/paths, direct guard regression evidence and putting class closure into the next review prompt. Target workflow only requires correction and affected-scope revalidation; ECC KISS/DRY and test quality do not require finding analogous instances or documenting the search. Thus fixing one duplicate incorrect claim or one unsafe boundary can pass while equivalent new defects remain. Port this as a bounded relevant-class check with search/test evidence, without repeated review quotas.

4. LOW — The source user-facing reporting contract is not retained. Source orchestrator user-report block requires the three-part reading/decision/archive summary for phase reports, plans, review outcomes and final reports, and per-round disposition/scope reporting. Target workflow final summary and read-only final response provide results/decisions/evidence/limits but no general phase-level actionable report or explicit scope self-check after review-driven edits. Exact emoji/table/count formatting may be intentionally simplified, but the portable behavior of showing what requires the user’s attention versus archived detail should be explicitly retained if full instruction parity is desired.

## Important limits

I did not treat target stronger all-HIGH plan cross-checking as a missing gate. Original structural/detail HIGH distinction and original PR-specific review-unit mechanics were not reported as defects because exam scope and no quota loops deliberately change them. Research’s access-failure-as-hold behavior is a sensible clarification of the source’s internally conflicting reject/unconfirmed instructions, not a fabricated-source acceptance gap. This is a bounded audit, not a universal no-omissions assertion.

# Independent semantic audit B

Compared raw source instructions/runtime at source HEAD `ab266415be98badcee06d06253c43921e1449614` and target HEAD `e1b49a272dd1a39b8e0e0d59981d72ec25e85005`. No other review results or parity inventory used as proof. No implementation edits or execution of installed harness.

## Remaining portable gaps

1. **Medium — fresh-task similar-work retrieval is missing.** Source `template/.claude/skills/harness-orchestrator/SKILL.md:23–25` requires a once-per-initial-execution search for prior attempts at the same/similar problem; its plugin-free fallback is `_workspace_prev/` and git history, and relevant results are injected into clarifier/planner. It expressly distinguishes previous attempts from canonical decisions and gives canonical decisions precedence when they conflict. Target `template/.agents/skills/kty-harness/SKILL.md:9–10`, workflow step 1, profile section 9, and decision-memory's resume/archive contract restore the current task and retrieve decisions, but never require searching previous task archives/git for similar failed/successful attempts on a *new* request or handing these results to the clarifier/planner. An archived failed approach can therefore be rediscovered without consulting available local evidence. This does not require claude-mem, private vault, export or external tools: search only the existing task-local archive and git history once, return relevant attempts or none, distinguish them from decisions, and record unavailable history honestly.

2. **Medium — ordinary fresh runs no longer perform the source startup drift check.** Source orchestrator line 22 requires a canonical comparison once on initial execution before work, motivated by stale orchestration dropping design dual review. Target `references/decision-memory.md:41–47` compares only on installation, update, worktree move or harness change. `SKILL.md:9–19` loads the installed instructions without requiring that comparison on an ordinary new task; the runtime SessionStart hook only fingerprints the task tree and records a baseline. Thus an old installed skill/role can be used without comparing it to an already-present newer imported package. This is a missing *procedural* trigger, not a demand to reproduce Claude PreToolUse enforcement or automatically overwrite local files. Add one initial-task comparison against the locally available imported package/install manifest, retaining legitimate slots and reporting absent/unverifiable upstream. No network or protected writes needed.

## Behaviors positively traced

- AGENTS.block -> main Skill -> workflow -> role TOMLs/reference contracts makes clarification, research-only, plan-only, review-only, explanation-only and architecture advice reachable. Installation failure/direct-read paths explicitly preserve these roles.
- Structural design and implementation planning have separate author and separate A/B review passes. Prior decisions, reference necessity, adjacent-domain exclusion, real code, invariants, alternatives, observation severity and gauge set/clear are covered.
- Research collector/evaluator separation, metadata, original-source checks, scoring axes, gaps, COI, contradictions and adopted-only synthesis are retained. Read-only returns responses rather than saving files.
- Explanation uses real diff/new-file contents and actual validation, separates intent from inference and delivery from file creation. Auditor checks actual stage calls and evidence, failed/unavailable execution, explanation delivery, runtime/submission limits and current verification.
- Native hooks are accurately limited to changed-tree/latest-verification assistance. Installer reports file installation separately from activation/validation; role CLI isolates its process read-only, closes stdin and defaults to no effort override. No basis found here for claiming these merely existing files prove successful runtime execution.

Allowed Sol/Sol, no fixed effort, no export/vault/PR/push/external AI/Claude plugins, no repeated clean-review quotas, read-only and limited-hook differences were excluded from findings. This report identifies observed concrete gaps; it does not certify universal semantic equivalence of all source behavior.
